{"id":191331,"tenderTitle":"PRESERVATION ASSETS OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCESERVICE (PAOM-SER)","tenderNumber":"1-13624","tenderDescription":"ESA operates one of the world's largest Earth Observation (EO) data archives, with data from missions dating back to the mid 1970s.Preserving these datatogether with the information and tools needed to interpret and use themis essential to analyse long-term environmental changes and support future decision-making.
